objective: Improve the existing turn-based party combat with a readable battle stage, ordered attack and impact playback, clear intentions and useful agent diagnostics without changing gameplay rules or saved continuation.

requirements.description: Present party and enemies as large facing sprites with readable initiative, health, statuses and icon-led abilities at the minimum window size.
Play anticipation, travel, impact and recovery in order, retain defeated fighters until finishing-hit playback completes, and defer rewards/endings until that sequence finishes.
Keep action legality, mana, helper commitments, combat randomness and round time independent of playback; prevent action overlap and retain exact save/load continuation.
Show planned enemy actions, targets and honest damage ranges without consuming randomness or changing saved enemy plans.
Provide mouse controls for playback speed, skipping, reduced motion and sound, pause presentation on focus loss, and reuse validated existing art with safe audio fallback.
Expose semantic presentation phases, extend repeatable native checks and capture their UI state, document authoring and validation, and close the milestone with fresh evidence.
